name: Completion
overview: Scripture reveals that completion is ultimately found in the perfect work of the Lord, who perfects what concerns His people and whose mercy endures forever, as expressed in Psalms 138:8. This completion is centered in Christ, the eternal Word who was with God and is God (John 1:1), and is experienced through faith in Him, granting everlasting life and passage from death to life (John 5:24; John 6:40). Jesus' words, spoken while He was present with His disciples (John 14:25), affirm that the fulfillment of God's will is tied to belief in the Son and the assurance of resurrection. The joy and continual prayer for believers, as Paul expresses in Philippians 1:4, reflect the ongoing spiritual reality of this divine completion.
